zoe: quick heads-up  small deploy tonight for llm-route v3 in eu-west. plan is a tiny FF ramp with session-pin for active users and a soft-drain on anomalies. posting runbook snippet.

deploybot: window 2026-04-03 22:00 UTC. command: `/deploybot ff ramp --name=llm-route-v3 --steps=0.5,3,15,100 --soak=10m --pin=active_sessions --safety=soft-drain`

sre_oncall: i'll watch first 30m. alert rules: error-rate +2% abs for 3m OR p95 > 350ms -> stepdown one level; REQ_ERRORS > 3x baseline for 2m -> ff set to 0 and pin rollback cohorts. will post dashboard link when ready.

zoe: release notes line: "llm-route v3 micro-canary with session pin and soft-drain safety. see runbook for thresholds." Keeping this thread as the canonical ops feed. :white_check_mark:
